mobbin:d3ffcd9d-2646-4c40-aa25-7fc37e0fb.summary: From Security & Drivers with Sentry Mode on, the user opens View live camera and lands on a Live Camera screen with one feed, a vehicle diagram of camera positions, Honk/Flash, and a record control.
steps: Security & Drivers — Sentry on + View live camera
Live Camera — feed + vehicle camera map
steal: Armed prerequisite: Sentry Mode toggle ON before View live camera (step 1) — live view gated on recording/monitor state.
Floor-plan style camera map: position dots + FOV wedges around the subject (step 2) — pick a camera by place, not by cryptic device name.
Single live preview above the map (step 2) — switch cameras without leaving the monitoring screen.
Grid control beside the map (step 2) — shortcut toward multi-angle layout from the same picker.
avoid: Honk / Flash vehicle actions on the camera screen (step 2) — wrong metaphor for sim rooms; keep space for PTZ/presets or room/simulator announce instead.
mobbin:d3ffcd9d-2646-4c40-aa25-7fc37e0fb.fit: Informs Center Overview / simplified camera picker outside full SRV rebuild: room diagram with camera dots to switch the live feed (not continuous PTZ steering; no face ID).
